items.text:
Let it be.

Gavin came back at 04:49, walked to the Cairn and typed `give spoon` twice — he's trying to repeat a trade he already completed; the spoon went to the old woman an hour ago and the flask is drunk. The refusal fired correctly both times, he checked his inventory in between, and he's four minutes into a fresh visit at 18/20. Two polite refusals is not stuck, and a voice out of the air explaining item bookkeeping would cost more than it gives. He hasn't gone near the door yet — that's the thing I'm watching for, and it warns twice on its own if he does.
